title: Claude or ChatGPT — how do you decide which one to use?
description: Every comparison expires in about a month. Here is a twenty-minute test you run on your own work instead, plus the four tells worth grading.

faq.a: The honest answer is that it depends on your work, and any ranking has a shelf life of weeks because both ship new models constantly. Run three prompts through both — your real work, a push-back reply, and a question about your own uploaded file — and grade the answers yourself. 'Both, for different things' is a legitimate result.

faq.q: What should you look for when comparing two AI assistants?
faq.a: Four tells. Did it do the whole instruction or the easy half; did it tell you what it changed; did it invent a fact you never gave it; and did it fold when you pushed back. The last one matters most — 'that's not right' should get a question back, not an instant apology and a worse answer.
